outcomes.text: Inquire into who we are, drawing on ideas that cross subject boundaries.

subtopics.title: Where we are in place and time

outcomes.text: Inquire into where we are in place and time, relating what is known to the wider world.
Inquire into the ways people express themselves.
Inquire into how the world works.
Inquire into how people and communities organize themselves.
Inquire into sharing the planet and taking meaningful action on local and global issues.
In the final year, explore, reflect on, document and share understanding of an issue of personal significance.

warnings: unit "Culminating project" (grade all) has a single outcome
